capabilities: sync the vault across desktop and mobile via the user's own Google Drive
encrypt file contents and names client-side using the rclone crypt standard
create rotating encrypted or plain vault snapshots from the command palette
exclude files and folders from sync via glob patterns or regular expressions
export settings including auth tokens via QR code or text string
extras: README states the code was AI-edited and the author is not a developer, urging users to back up first; some features such as backup explorer/restore are command-palette only; the manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author forked crypt-drive-sync because they "modified it to the level that i needed for personal use" and wanted cross-platform (desktop and mobile) support.
problem: Obsidian's official Sync is a paid service, and users who want to sync through their own cloud storage cannot do so with end-to-end encryption and no lock-in.

relations.evidence: Forked and extended from crypt-drive-sync by mooncodee.
Because Google Drive+ uses standard Rclone crypt formatting, you can mount, browse, or sync your vault using Rclone

requires.name: Google Cloud OAuth Client ID and Secret (user-created)
rclone (for direct external access to the encrypted vault)

summary: Encrypted vault sync to your own Google Drive using rclone crypt format, with rolling vault snapshots, multi-vault paths, and glob/regex sync filters.
